Bug_Title: Eq: equals method always returns false (EQ_ALWAYS_FALSE)
Bug_Explanation: This class defines an equals method that always returns false. This means that an object is not equal to itself, and it is impossible to create useful Maps or Sets of this class. More fundamentally, it means that equals is not reflexive, one of the requirements of the equals method. The likely intended semantics are object identity: that an object is equal to itself. This is the behavior inherited from class Object. If you need to override an equals inherited from a different superclass, you can use: Object public boolean equals(Object o) { return this == o; }
